brief:
Palestinian organizations have called for a national march in London to demonstrate against what they characterize as British complicity in the Gaza conflict, Middle East Eye reported. The march aims to pressure the UK government to end Israeli attacks and ensure unrestricted humanitarian access to Gaza.

The groups are mobilizing supporters to demand that Britain take concrete action to halt military operations in the territory. Organizers plan to use the demonstration to hold the government accountable for its current stance on the ongoing hostilities and call for a shift in British policy toward the region.
